rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and visible ICM/TE, but some image-specific claims are overconfident (e.g., blastocoel ~60%, clear circumferential cohesive TE, zona thinning) given the limited single focal plane and partial visualization.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, FSH, uterine factor, prior IVF outcomes including prior live birth, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and embryo grade into prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible adjustment from baseline embryo prognosis for uterine factor and prior history; minor issues include somewhat arbitrary percentage adjustments and labeling this as RIF without nuance.

Core morphology interpretation and emphasis on uterine evaluation are aligned, but several recommendations (ERA, EMMA/ALICE, aspirin, LMWH, IVIG/intralipid, NK testing, MTHFR) are not routinely guideline-supported for general use and are presented too favorably.

Provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer optimization and contingency planning, though some proposed tests/interventions are more speculative than standard and should be more selectively framed.
